eras.name: Classical
eras.tools: reduced-order models · control theory · convex optimisation

eras.name: Learning-based
eras.tools: GPU-parallel simulation · reinforcement learning · imitation learning
eras.considers: physics-based simulation, specific limited real-world data

eras.name: Emerging
eras.tools: foundation models · world models · diffusion models
eras.tasks: multi-task loco-manipulation in the open world

milestones.title: Zero-moment point
milestones.note: The balance criterion behind decades of walking pattern generators: keep the point where the net ground moment vanishes inside the support polygon.

milestones.title: WABOT-1
milestones.note: The first full-scale anthropomorphic robot to walk, slowly, on two legs (context, not cited by the survey).

milestones.title: Raibert's hopping and running machines
milestones.who: Marc Raibert, Legged Robots That Balance
milestones.note: Dynamic balance from a compliant reduced-order model and foot placement: hopping height, forward speed and body attitude each get one simple loop.

milestones.title: Honda P2, then ASIMO (2000)
milestones.note: Quasi-static ZMP walking on a full humanoid, the first widely seen one.

milestones.title: 3-D linear inverted pendulum
milestones.note: Constant CoM height makes the pendulum linear; the model behind ZMP preview control, capture points and the balance lab on this page.

milestones.title: ZMP preview control
milestones.note: A CoM trajectory that tracks a planned ZMP with a preview of the next second: the workhorse of humanoid walking for a decade.

milestones.title: Hybrid zero dynamics
milestones.note: Nonlinear feedback on the full hybrid model of an underactuated biped: enforce virtual constraints and stabilise the remaining zero dynamics.

milestones.title: Capture point
milestones.note: Where to step to come to rest: the point x + ẋ/ω of the LIP. Foot placement and CoM control in one quantity.

milestones.title: DARPA Robotics Challenge (2013–2015)
milestones.who: DARPA; Atlas, HUBO, HRP-2 and others
milestones.note: Offline trajectory optimisation and whole-body quadratic programs on full humanoids, in a competition setting.

milestones.title: Deep RL arrives: DQN, TRPO, then PPO (2017)
milestones.note: Human-level Atari from pixels, trust-region and proximal policy optimisation: the algorithms that later train every walking policy.

milestones.title: Cassie
milestones.note: A commercial underactuated biped that became the test bed of both HZD control and the first sim-to-real RL bipeds.

milestones.title: Convex MPC on MIT Cheetah 3
milestones.note: A single-rigid-body model and a QP solved every few milliseconds: online predictive control that inspired humanoid MPC.

milestones.title: Atlas parkour (2018–2021)
milestones.note: Offline-optimised, online-tracked whole-body behaviours: jumps, flips and a parkour course.

milestones.title: Learning agile motor skills for legged robots
milestones.note: RL policies on ANYmal with a learned actuator network to close the sim-to-real gap.

milestones.title: Teacher–student locomotion over challenging terrain
milestones.note: A privileged teacher, a proprioceptive student, an adaptive curriculum: blind quadrupeds on mud, snow and rubble.

milestones.title: Sim-to-real RL bipeds; Isaac Gym
milestones.who: Siekmann et al. (Cassie stairs); Makoviychuk et al.
milestones.note: Blind stair climbing on Cassie from simulation-trained policies, and thousands of parallel environments on one GPU.

milestones.title: Learning to walk in minutes
milestones.note: Massively parallel PPO with a terrain curriculum: a walking policy in minutes of wall-clock time.

milestones.title: Unitree H1, then G1 (2024)
milestones.note: Affordable full-size and child-size humanoids; the platform of most recent RL humanoid papers.

milestones.title: Human motion in the loop: ExBody, H2O, HumanPlus
milestones.who: Cheng et al.; He et al.; Fu et al.
milestones.note: Retargeted motion capture as tracking rewards: expressive whole-body control and real-time human-to-humanoid teleoperation.

milestones.title: Humanoid locomotion as next-token prediction
milestones.note: A transformer trained on sensorimotor sequences walks a humanoid in San Francisco: locomotion as sequence modelling.

milestones.title: Vision-language-action models: π0
milestones.note: Internet-scale pre-training plus a flow-matching action head, for general robot control.

milestones.title: Humanoid foundation models: Helix, GR00T N1, Gemini Robotics
milestones.note: Vision, proprioception and language in one latent policy, usually with a separate low-level locomotion module.

milestones.title: ASAP: aligning simulation and real physics
milestones.note: A residual action model learned from real-world rollouts corrects the simulator for agile whole-body skills.

milestones.title: BeyondMimic and SONIC
milestones.note: Guided diffusion over tracked motions; a VLA handing kinematic intent to a whole-body tracking policy.

milestones.title: This survey
milestones.who: Gu, Shi, Shi, ... Cheng, ... Su, Sreenath, Science Robotics 11(117)
milestones.note: Three eras, three shared principles (physics-based modelling, constrained decision making, adaptation to uncertainty), and the case for physics-guided generative control.
